title: SpecRead: A Benchmark for Measuring Whether Language Models Understand Hardware Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2609.33699v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) in hardware design evaluate downstream artifacts such as generated RTL, assertions, or testbenches. When a model fails, it may have misread the specification or understood it and failed to write the code. We present SpecRead, a benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability. SpecRead v2.2 contains 383 questions over 10 open-source OpenTitan IP blocks in four types: exact retrieval, cross-section reasoning, contradiction detection in mutated specifications, and spec-RTL consistency checking, plus 41 distractor controls and 41 consistent-RTL controls. Type-4 items use real RTL mutations retained only when Icarus Verilog simulation shows a behavioral change. A with-spec vs. without-spec ablation suggests the questions require the excerpt rather than training recall alone, though it does not rule out memorization of the unmutated source text helping a model

translated_title: SpecRead：衡量语言模型是否理解硬件规格的基准测试
translated_abstract: 现有针对大语言模型（LLM）在硬件设计领域的基准测试主要评估下游产物，例如生成的RTL、断言或测试台。当模型失败时，可能是它误读了规格说明，也可能是它理解了规格但未能写出代码。我们提出了SpecRead，这是一个将规格理解能力与生成能力分离的基准测试。SpecRead v2.2 包含针对10个开源OpenTitan IP模块的383道题目，分为四种类型：精确检索、跨章节推理、变异规格中的矛盾检测，以及规格-RTL一致性检查，另外还有41个干扰对照组和41个一致RTL对照组。第四类题目使用真实的RTL变异，只有当Icarus Verilog仿真显示出行为变化时才会保留。有规格与无规格的消融实验表明，这些题目需要依赖规格摘录而非仅靠训练记忆，但这并不能排除模型对未变异源文本的记忆可能带来的帮助。
tldr: SpecRead是一个将硬件规格理解能力与代码生成能力分离的新基准测试，通过针对OpenTitan IP模块的四类题目（精确检索、跨章节推理、矛盾检测和规格-RTL一致性检查）来评估大语言模型对硬件规格的真实理解程度。
en_tdlr: SpecRead is a new benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability, using 383 questions in four types over OpenTitan IP blocks to measure whether LLMs truly understand hardware specifications.
